title: Change the separating liquid, not the plastic sample
title_de: Das Trennmedium ändern, nicht die Kunststoffprobe
question: How does a liquid-density change alter the potential separation of polystyrene and PET?
script:
# D3-PO-002: Change the separating liquid, not the plastic sample
# Simulation candidate; no runtime observations are claimed.
register lv3
new
add v1 water 50mL
add v1 PS 0.5g
add v1 PET 0.5g
add v2 water 50mL
add v2 NaCl 8g
add v2 PS 0.5g
add v2 PET 0.5g
measure v1 density
measure v2 density
look v1
look v2
inspect
expected_result: Compare measured liquid density with each polymer density. A denser brine may cross the PS threshold while remaining below PET, allowing a different classification than pure water.
limitations: This is a density-based feasibility test, not a guaranteed particle-separation operation. Surface wetting, trapped air and polymer additives are not represented.
